licenseDetail: geoBoundaries metadata lists the AFG ADM1 boundary as Public Domain. geoBoundaries project code and derivative works are released under CC BY 4.0; attribution to geoBoundaries is required.
attribution: Runfola D, Anderson A, Baier H, Crittenden M, Dowker E, Fuhrig S, et al. (2020) geoBoundaries: A global database of political administrative boundaries. PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0231866
notes: The geometry represents a 2007 boundary year and is a generalised cartographic dataset. It is not a legal or survey-grade boundary source.
The source uses non-canonical shapeISO values for Badakhshan (AF-BDN) and Kandahar (AF_KAN); both are normalised to ISO 3166-2 codes.
The source shapeName 'Ghanzi' is normalised to the English name 'Ghazni'.
No runtime downloads occur. Geometry is projected and simplified once during development and committed with the package.
